summary: IR Thermography File-Based Image Storage Fix - All backend tests passed (15/15). The fix successfully stores images as files instead of base64 in MongoDB to bypass the 16MB document limit.

minor.issue: PDF generation fails with 500 error when image files contain invalid data (not valid JPEG/PNG). This is expected behavior but could use better error handling to skip invalid images gracefully.

action_items: Consider adding error handling in PDF generation to skip invalid images instead of failing the entire PDF
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ save_base64_image() correctly converts base64 to file and returns URL path
✓ process_inspection_items_images() properly processes items and saves images as files
✓ Existing URL images are preserved (not re-processed)
✓ Report deletion cleans up associated image files
✓ PDF generation works with both base64 and file-based images (when valid)
seed_data_creation: Test reports created with TEST_ prefix during testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: IR Thermography file-based image storage fix verified. Key endpoints: POST /api/ir-thermography (create with images), PUT /api/ir-thermography/{id} (update), GET /api/ir-thermography/{id} (retrieve), DELETE /api/ir-thermography/{id} (delete with file cleanup), GET /api/ir-thermography-report/{id}/pdf (PDF generation). Images stored in /app/uploads/ir-thermography/{report_id}/ and served via /ir-thermography-images/ URL path.
